III. Reading passage (Questions 32-37)

Reading Text

Music and arts play an important role in students’ lives. Many students enjoy listening to music, especially classical and pop music. Others like playing instruments such as the piano or guitar. Painting and photography are also popular. Some students think painting is different from photography, but both are creative. Students often visit art galleries or attend concerts to enjoy these activities. Music and arts help students relax and express their feelings. They also make life more interesting and enjoyable.

32. What is the best title for this passage?

33. What do students enjoy in their free time according to the passage?

34. What does the word "both" refer to?

35. Where do students often go to enjoy these creative activities?

36. Which hobby is NOT mentioned in the reading passage?

37. Why are music and arts important for secondary students?

D

PART D: WRITING (2.6 POINTS)

Sắp xếp từ, hoàn thành câu nâng cao và điền từ đoạn văn.

I. Arrange words to make meaningful sentences (Questions 38-40)

Từ cho sẵn: / like / I / painting /

Từ cho sẵn: / music / is / different from / rock /

Từ cho sẵn: / this / is / as / not / as / that /

II. Complete sentences (Questions 41-45)

41. I like painting. My hobby is ______.

42. She enjoys taking photos. She likes ______ photos.

43. Do you like music? Are you interested ______ music?

44. He prefers painting to drawing. He likes painting ______ drawing.

45. Rock music is different from classical music. Rock music is not ______ classical music.

Ms. Lily's Quick Grammar & Vocab Review

1. Cấu trúc so sánh bằng & không bằng:

  • S + be + as + adj + as + N/Pronoun.
  • S + be + not + as + adj + as + N/Pronoun.
  • Ví dụ: This painting is as big as that one.

2. Cấu trúc khác biệt & sở thích:

  • be different from ... (Khác với...)
  • prefer doing sth to doing sth... (Thích làm cái này hơn cái kia...)
  • enoy/like + V-ing (Yêu thích làm gì...)
